scholarships.title: Banach NAWA Scholarship Programme
scholarships.official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA) / Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland

existing.funding_period: per month, plus a PLN 2,500 travel allowance
existing.description: The Banach NAWA programme funds full-time second-cycle (master's) studies conducted in Polish or English at universities supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education. It is a joint initiative of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland and the Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange, delivered as Polish development aid, and is open to citizens of the 36 countries covered by Polish Aid in Eastern Europe, Asia, Africa and Latin America. Benefits published by NAWA are a monthly scholarship of PLN 2,500, exemption from tuition fees at public universities, a PLN 2,500 travel allowance, a NAWA-funded preparatory course for the Polish track, and a Polish language and culture course for the English track. The call for applications for the winter semester 2026/27 is Announcement No. 16/2026 of 13 April 2026.
eligibility: Citizens of one of the 36 countries covered by Polish Aid, located in Eastern Europe, Asia, Africa or Latin America
Admission to full-time second-cycle (master's) studies conducted in Polish or English
The host institution must be a university supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education that has concluded a framework agreement with NAWA (published as Attachment 2 to the call)
Polish-track applicants may be required to attend the NAWA-funded preparatory course; English-track applicants receive a Polish language and culture course
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to citizens of the 36 countries covered by Polish Aid, from Eastern Europe, Asia, Africa and Latin America, applying for full-time second-cycle (master's) studies in Polish or English at universities supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education. The full list of eligible countries is published in the call announcement.
benefits: Full tuition fee exemption at public universities
Language and preparatory support depending on track
coverage: Exemption from tuition fees at public universities
NAWA-funded preparatory course for the Polish track
Polish language and culture course for the English track
requirements: Apply only for a full-time second-cycle programme at a university supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education with a framework agreement with NAWA
Submit through the NAWA application system within the deadline stated in the call announcement
Choose the Polish track with the NAWA-funded preparatory course or the English track with the Polish language and culture course
Use a language certificate from NAWA's published list of recognised certificates
Abide by the NAWA Regulations for natural persons taking up education and research stays in Poland (Attachment 1 to the call)
documents: Application form submitted through the NAWA system
Academic certificates for the level applied for, as required by the call
Language certificate from the List of Recognized English Language Certificates or the List of Recognized Polish Language Certificates (Attachments 3 and 4 to the call)
Doctoral applicants only: master's degree certificate or proof of eligibility to start doctoral studies
Confirmation of admission or pre-admission from the chosen Polish university where required by the call
existing.english_requirement: Applicants on the English track must provide a recognised English language certificate; NAWA publishes a List of Recognized English Language Certificates as Attachment 4 to each call.
application_method: Check that your country appears in the eligible-country list in the call announcement
Choose a Polish university with a framework agreement with NAWA (Attachment 2) and secure admission
Prepare the application and language certificate required by the call
Submit the application through the NAWA system before the closing date stated in the announcement
If shortlisted, sit the host institution's entrance examination and language check
existing.selection_notes: Selection is run by NAWA together with the host universities: applicants are assessed on academic merit through the university's entrance examination and language verification, then ranked against the available places. The programme is explicitly a development-aid instrument, so the stated goal is "to support the socio-economic development of developing countries by improving the level of education and professional qualifications of their citizens".
existing.best_fit: Citizens of the 36 Polish Aid countries who hold or are completing a first degree and can secure admission to a full-time English-taught or Polish-taught master's programme at a supervised Polish university.
existing.notes: Amounts confirmed on NAWA's programme page. The full terms, exact closing date and place limits per field are in the call announcement PDF, which the fetch tool returned as raw unparseable bytes, so no additional figures are asserted here.
existing.duration: Banach NAWA programme offers scholarships for full-time second-cycle studies conducted in Polish or English at universities supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education.
existing.application_period: One call per academic year. For the winter semester 2026/27 intake the call was announced on 13 April 2026 (No. 16/2026) and has already closed; the next annual call is expected in spring 2027 for the 2027/28 winter semester.
existing.deadline_display: Announcement of a call for applications No. 16/2026 of 13 April 2026, for studies or preparatory course from the winter semester 2026/27. The exact closing date is published inside the call PDF and could not be read.

scholarships.title: Ulam NAWA Programme
scholarships.degree: Doctoral (employs researchers holding at least a doctoral degree)
scholarships.official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)

existing.description: The Ulam NAWA Programme is an institutional programme of the Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange that lets Polish higher education and research institutions employ outstanding scientists from abroad for 6 to 24 months, with projects starting between 1 February and 1 December 2027. The funding covers remuneration of the invited Principal Investigator up to PLN 17,000 per month including employer costs and an allowance of up to PLN 1,200 per month for the Inviting Person, with a maximum of PLN 436,800 per project. Invited scientists conduct research, postdoctoral training, publication work and grant preparation, with teaching as a complementary activity, and the programme is open to all disciplines. Applications are submitted by the Polish host institution in English through NAWA's ICT system; the 2026 call closed on 15 May 2026 at 3:00 p.m. CET with results due by 30 November 2026.
eligibility: Applicant must be a Polish higher education institution or research institute
Principal Investigator must hold at least a doctoral degree
Principal Investigator must be employed at a foreign higher education or research institution, or have completed such employment after 31 August 2025
Principal Investigator must not have worked or studied in Poland in the 3 years before the call deadline, nor stayed in Poland for more than 3 consecutive months in that period
Principal Investigator must demonstrate at least 3 significant scientific achievements within the last 5 years
Polish citizens may account for at most 10% of funded Principal Investigators in a call
existing.eligibility_summary: The applicant and beneficiary of funding is a Polish higher education or research institution, which invites a Principal Investigator from abroad. The Principal Investigator must hold at least a doctoral degree, be employed at a foreign higher education or research institution, not have worked or studied in Poland in the three years before the deadline, and demonstrate at least three significant scientific achievements in the last five years.
benefits: Full-time employment in Poland for 6 to 24 months
Principal Investigator remuneration up to PLN 17,000 per month including employer costs
Inviting Person allowance up to PLN 1,200 per month
Simplified MSCA track for Seal of Excellence and MSCA4Ukraine awardees
coverage: Remuneration of the Principal Investigator up to PLN 17,000 per month, including employer costs
Remuneration of the Inviting Person up to PLN 1,200 per month as a task-based allowance
requirements: Cooperation agreement between the scientist abroad and a Polish host institution
Agreement on project scope and employment conditions
Application submitted by the host institution in English through the NAWA ICT system
existing.english_requirement: The application must be prepared in English.
application_method: The invited scientist agrees project scope and employment conditions with a Polish host institution
The host institution submits the application electronically in the NAWA ICT system at https://programs.nawa.gov.pl, in English
existing.selection_notes: Applications are subject to scientific evaluation, except under the simplified MSCA track, where NAWA recognises the European evaluation as proof of excellence.
existing.notes: The programme is open to all scientific disciplines and applications are submitted by inviting institutions, not by individual researchers.
existing.duration: 6 to 24 months of full-time employment at the Polish host institution; projects must start between 1 February and 1 December 2027
existing.application_period: Annual call; the 2026 call closed on 15 May 2026 and results are due by 30 November 2026 for projects starting between 1 February and 1 December 2027
existing.deadline_display: Deadline for submission: 15 May 2026, 3:00 PM (CET). Results will be announced by 30 November 2026.
existing.program_type: Institutional research programme funding employment of foreign scientists in Poland
